{{Quote|We have Choster's sister. So either way, someone is going to pay. Hand over Choster or we kill the sister...I doubt you want her blood on your hands.|[[Cale Serasai]], to a Lok Revenant|<ref name="SWG:NP" />}}
'''Sheeli''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the sister of [[Choster]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|We want Choster. If we don't get Choster, the female Twi'lek dies!|Cale Serasai, to a Lok Revenant|<ref name="SWG:NP" />}}
Sheeli had a brother, a skilled [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] named [[Choster]].<ref name="SWG:NP" /> At some point, Choster was recruited to set up the defenses of the [[Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout|secret hideout]] of the [[Sulfur Lake Pirates]]. Then, he barely escaped death when the pirates attempted to assassinate him when the job was done rather than pay him.<ref name="SWG:SwC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak with Choster|Lok}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Choster eagerly accepted to help [[Nym/Legends|Nym's]] [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], the enemies of the Sulfur Lake Pirates, to raid the Sulfur Lake Pirate Hideout. However, the pirates then discovered that Choster was involved in the attack. As the engineer was protected by Nym, the pirates instead captured Sheeli. A meeting later took place in [[Kimogila Town]] between the Lok Revenants and the Sulfur Lake Pirates. There, the pirate [[Cale Serasai]] revealed that they had captured Sheeli and threatened to kill her if the Revenants did not hand over Choster to him. A firefight soon erupted between the two groups of criminals. Although the Lok Revenants were outnumbered, they successfully defended themselves and killed most of the pirates. Cale Serasai survived the fight and was forced to release Sheeli in exchange for his life. The woman was eventually freed and brought to a secret location under the protection of Nym.<ref name="SWG:NP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sheeli appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sheeli was added to the game as part of the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:NP" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
